name: Marina Valle
source:
Affiliated with the 40Percent, Spectra is a radical militant who combines ideological fervor with cold-blooded composure. Determined and methodical, she does not seek violence for its own sake, but does not hesitate to use it when she deems it necessary. Her ability lets her alter how others perceive her presence, disrupting the attention, senses, and memory of those around her.

[In game description]
